name: tcms-packages
description: Workspace root for the TypeScript packages that talk to the TCMS API. Deliberately NOT at the repository root: the root runs docker compose and nothing else (CLAUDE.md), and backend/ and frontend/ are independent stacks that must keep building on their own. This root has no build of its own either — it exists so @tcms/cli and @tcms/mcp can resolve @tcms/client without a file: dependency or a publish step between every change. THE BUILD SCRIPT NAMES ITS ORDER: `--workspaces` runs them ALPHABETICALLY, so `cli` went before `client` and typechecked against the previous build's dist/ — a client change was invisible to its only consumer until the command was run twice. Use `npm run build` here, not `npm run build --workspaces`. @tcms/mcp is third and alphabetical order would have put it second, before the client it is built on.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tcms/client && npm run build -w @tcms/cli && npm run build -w @tcms/mcp
